source: requirement.ja.md section 1, with section 2 naming what the text leaves open

rules.name: legal_name_authority
rules.statement: The legal name comes from the register, not from the sales master.
rules.evidence: 法人名称については登記情報を正とする

rules.name: commercial_name_preserved
rules.statement: The sales facing customer name is carried forward unchanged.
rules.evidence: 営業側で使用する取引先名称については既存名称を維持する

rules.name: no_auto_merge_on_shared_houjin_bangou
rules.statement: Two customers sharing one corporate number are not merged automatically when either is managed at store level.
rules.evidence: 法人番号が一致する場合でも、店舗単位で管理している取引先は自動統合せず

rules.name: hierarchy_retained
rules.statement: The relationship between the corporate customer and its store customers is kept explicitly.
rules.evidence: 親子関係として保持する

rules.name: closed_store_history_retained
rules.statement: A closed store keeps its own record and its own validity period.
rules.evidence: 閉店済店舗については履歴を保持し

rules.name: no_auto_reassignment_to_new_store
rules.statement: A closed store is not automatically substituted by a new store, however similar the address.
rules.evidence: 新規店舗への自動付替えは行わない

rules.name: houjin_bangou_is_identity_evidence_not_a_merge_key
rules.statement: The corporate number is strong identity evidence and is used to link, but it is never on its own sufficient to merge two customer records.
rules.evidence: Follows from 法人番号が一致する場合でも ... 自動統合せず, which presumes the number is meaningful yet insufficient. The text never says this in one sentence.

rules.name: historical_transactions_stay_with_the_historical_store
rules.statement: Transactions booked against a store that has since closed remain pointed at that store.
rules.evidence: Follows from 履歴を保持 combined with 自動付替えは行わない. The text does not name transactions at all.

rules.name: corporate_record_is_the_parent
rules.statement: In the retained hierarchy the corporate customer is the parent and the store customer is the child.
rules.evidence: The text says 親子関係として保持する but never says which side is the parent. The assumption follows the sales master parent_customer_id column, which already points from store to corporate.
rules.open_question: Confirm with the business that the direction in the sales master is the direction they mean.

rules.name: payment_terms_precedence
rules.statement: Which system wins for payment terms when the sales system and CRM disagree is not decided.
rules.evidence: requirement.ja.md section 2 states the disagreement exists and states no rule. Section 1 is silent on 支払条件.
rules.open_question: 支払条件が営業システムとCRMで異なる場合、どちらを正とするか。移行時点の値を凍結するのか、CRM側を追随させるのか。

rules.name: legal_name_correction_effective_date
rules.statement: The date from which a corrected legal name applies is not decided, and neither is the display name on past documents.
rules.evidence: requirement.ja.md section 2 states both options and picks neither. Section 1 makes the register authoritative without dating the correction.
rules.open_question: 法人名称の訂正は登記更新日から反映するのか、移行実施日から反映するのか。過去伝票の表示名称は当時の名称のままとするのか。
